Markup-fidelity fixture for the LAYOUT wrapper — `.pc-layout` (keen `PureAdmin.Components.Layout.layout/1`, svelte `layout/Layout.svelte`). A SHELL component migrated DOWN into @keenmate/pure-css, so the block class is `pc-layout` (NOT `pa-layout`); confirmed in dist/css/main.css. SCOPE = CONTAINER-ONLY. Canonical shape from snippets/layout.html: `
…sidebar + content…
…
` — the layout wrapper sits below the navbar and hosts the inner (sidebar+content) row plus the footer. Both wrappers render a bare `
{children}
` — the INNER/CONTENT/SIDEBAR/MAIN/FOOTER structure is supplied by SEPARATE sub-components fed through the slot (keen layout_inner/layout_content/sidebar/main/footer; svelte LayoutInner/LayoutContent/Sidebar/Main/Footer), out of scope here (container-only). So the reconcilable shape is slot-content-supplied: `
{slot}
`. The block modifier `pc-layout--sticky` is a BODY-LEVEL flag (applied to , toggled by JS/localStorage — see the snippet), NOT emitted by this component by either wrapper, so it is claimed via cssStateClasses. All `pc-layout__*` element classes come from the slot-fed sub-components → deferred as prose. Canonical shape: packages/core/snippets/layout.html.

propsVocabulary.body: the layout's contents — in a real app the pc-layout__inner (sidebar + content) + pc-layout__footer sub-components; here a plain slot token (container-only scope). svelte `children`, keen `inner_block`.
propsVocabulary.extraClass: extra classes appended verbatim to the root <div class="pc-layout ..."> (svelte `class`, keen `class`) — class passthrough; not a core modifier.

goldenConventions:
Container-only — `
{body}
`. The body slot is a plain text token so the diff checks the container tag + class + nesting, not the slot-fed sub-component structure. The body-level `pc-layout--sticky` flag is not exercised (not emitted by this component). Attribute + class-token order and whitespace are normalized away.

features.//: Feature→class contract authored from dist/css/main.css (grep '\.pc-layout(--|__)'). The `.pc-layout` BLOCK has ONE modifier, `pc-layout--sticky`, but it is a BODY-LEVEL flag (on <body>, JS/localStorage-toggled) NOT emitted by this component → claimed via cssStateClasses so axis-1's reverse block-modifier check stays clean. Its element classes (__inner/__content/__footer/__main/__sidebar/__sidebar--icon-collapse/__sidebar__nav) are all emitted by SEPARATE slot-fed sub-components → deferred. So the container contract is: the base class + a body slot + a class passthrough. `produces: null` everywhere.

body.note: the layout contents (slot-fed sub-components in a real app); svelte `children`, keen `inner_block`. Structural — produces no class.

extraClass.note: class passthrough — appended verbatim to the root pc-layout div; svelte `class`, keen `class`.

cssStateClasses.//: The pc-layout--sticky block modifier is a BODY-LEVEL layout-mode flag applied to <body> (see snippets/layout.html: `<body class="pc-layout--sticky">`) and toggled by the sidebar JS / localStorage — NEVER emitted on the .pc-layout element by either wrapper. Claimed here so axis-1's reverse block-modifier check counts it, without inventing a layout/1 feature that produces it.
cssStateClasses.pc-layout--sticky: fixed-viewport mode: body overflow:hidden, .pc-layout is 100vh, the content wrapper scrolls internally. A <body> class toggled by JS/localStorage (sidebar-mode=sticky), not a layout/1 prop. Not part of the blessed SSR markup of this component.

deferred.//: Every `pc-layout__*` element class belongs to a SEPARATE slot-fed sub-component (layout_inner/layout_content/sidebar/main/footer), not the pc-layout container shell — the container only emits the base `<div class="pc-layout">`. Acknowledged as PROSE (their own slices: main.json covers pc-layout__main; footer.json covers pc-layout__footer; sidebar.json covers pc-layout__sidebar + --icon-collapse + __nav).
deferred.pc-layout__inner: the flex-row wrapper hosting sidebar + content; emitted by the layout_inner/LayoutInner sub-component fed into the slot — its own future slice.
deferred.pc-layout__content: the <main>-wrapping scroll container; emitted by the layout_content/LayoutContent sub-component — its own future slice.
deferred.pc-layout__main: the <main> content region; emitted by main/1 / Main — covered by main.json.
deferred.pc-layout__footer: the page footer; emitted by footer/1 / Footer — covered by footer.json.
deferred.pc-layout__sidebar: the sidebar column; emitted by sidebar/1 / Sidebar — covered by sidebar.json.
deferred.pc-layout__sidebar--icon-collapse: icon-rail sidebar modifier; emitted by sidebar/1 / Sidebar — covered by sidebar.json.
deferred.pc-layout__sidebar__nav: the <nav> wrapper the sidebar emits around its <ul>; emitted by sidebar/1 / Sidebar — covered by sidebar.json.

scenarios.name: body
scenarios.note: Container-only: the bare pc-layout wrapper around its slot (real children are the inner row + footer sub-components).

scenarios.name: extra-class
scenarios.note: Class passthrough — the extra class is appended after pc-layout; token order is normalized away.
